description:
Generate a formatted bibliography for the cases in the 'Warren Court' collection. 

1. Select the 'Warren Court' collection in the left sidebar.
2. Select all 3 cases in the collection (Brown v. Board, Gideon v. Wainwright, Miranda v. Arizona).
3. Right-click the selection and choose 'Create Bibliography from Items...'
4. Select 'Indigo (Law Review)' as the citation style (or 'Bluebook Law Review' if Indigo is missing).
5. Choose 'Save as RTF' as the output method.
6. Save the file to '/home/ga/Documents/warren_bibliography.rtf'.
